_doc: Footnotes as printed. For each article listed, notes[] is rebuilt in this order: n = the printed 「註解N」 number, src = index of the note in site/data/a/NN.json notes[], has = text that note must contain (the build stops if it does not, or if a source note is left out). Checked against the publication's printed notes pages. A leading 「註解N」 label still inside a note's text is stripped by the build and must name n; a label that names several numbers (「註解3、4」) is kept as notes[].label.

11._print: The printed notes list runs 註解1–27 in this order. Two stay as printed because the right source cannot be told: 16 after 共同影響最後的結果 (13 or 14) and 17 after 遊戲與家電品牌 (15 or 16, neither mentions the brands).
